race.comment: BLUEBIRD BAY (2) saves his best form for this mile journey with a win and two placings from four attempts and should get a cosy run in transit from gate two. Gets the services of Holt in the irons and should be right there at the business end. ROCK THE SUNRISE (5) was a touch plain at the latest effort but the form prior was full of merit. Only needs some luck navigating from the sticky alley to be playing a major role in the outcome. LONE FORCE (4) has placed two of three around this circuit and is usually about the money. Top-three credentials on best figures. INTRUDER (3) gets 3kg weight relief with the claim and looks one for the multiples. The well-related ECLIPSION (6) (full to Listed winner and G2 placed Far Too Easy) best of the rest.
